contracts.action: After a committed switch or an active-folder relocate, afterCommit now recomputes and rebroadcasts the effective settings (notifyOverridesChanged) before the titles, workspace state and library are refreshed
contracts.equivalent_path: The WorkspaceSettings `changed` callback wired to notifyOverridesChanged at init (index.ts:130). Overrides are read for the target in persistActive (index.ts:423-428) before the commit
contracts.before_after: switchWorkspace awaits persistActive, which calls reg.setActive and then workspaceSettings.refresh(target). Only after that do dropPendingCaptures and afterCommit(gate.commit(target)) run (switch-transaction.ts:72-80). So when notifyOverridesChanged reads activeOverrides, activeId already points at the target and its overrides are cached. A failed persist throws before afterCommit runs, so no broadcast goes out and the old workspace stays active. relocateActive calls the same afterCommit (switch-transaction.ts:135-136), and there the call is a no-op unless the effective settings changed (settings-store.ts:233-235)
contracts.visible_effect: notifyOverridesChanged wakes the main listeners and sends settings:changed to every window when the effective snapshot differs (settings-store.ts:232-238), so each window shows the new workspace's settings
contracts.failure_mode: refresh can fail inside persistActive. In that case the overrides stay inactive, per the comment at index.ts:425-426, and the effective settings fall back to the All level. This is visible in Settings as the default values. A throw inside persistActive reopens the gate and aborts the windows (switch-transaction.ts:73-76)

structuredOutput.summary:
I found no problems in either file.

- **`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/workspaces/index.ts`:** at 543053c, the `notifyOverridesChanged()` call sat outside the `persistActive` function, inside the object literal, which is not valid code. It now runs inside `afterCommit`. That hook runs only after `persistActive` has set the target as active and refreshed its overrides (`switch-transaction.ts:72-80`), so the broadcast carries the new workspace's effective settings.
  - A failed persist never reaches the broadcast.
  - The relocate path now calls it too, which does no harm: it returns early when nothing changed (`settings-store.ts:233-235`).
